name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_show_modal_and_get_selected_mission_index
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::ShowModalAndGetSelectedMissionIndex constructs the upgrade dialogs, exposes their globals during the modal run, hides and restores the frame menu bar, and reports the selected mission index.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

The implementation uses explicit raw stack storage and a direct CDialog::DoModal provider call to preserve functional provider behavior; original bytes still include EH cleanup ladders and vtable-slot dispatch shape that require a later coherent tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43efe0 validates stack construction of WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog and WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog, copying g_RecoilApp.m_hInstance into g_hWestwoodOnlineUpgradeModuleInstance, publishing g_pWestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog and g_pWestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog, hiding the main frame menu bar before the modal provider call, initializing g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeSelectedMissionIndex to -1, restoring the menu bar after the modal call, returning 0 when the global remains -1, and otherwise writing the selected mission index to the ECX out pointer and returning 1.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_show_modal_smoke patches MFC provider calls and CZRecoilFrame::SetMenuBarVisibility, verifies the published dialog globals and vtable markers are visible during DoModal, checks the hide/show menu sequence, validates the success and cancel return paths, and confirms explicit cleanup destroys the child control, CString, and CDialog provider subobjects exactly once per constructed dialog.
